name: TEXONO
summary: TEXONO is a multipurpose low-energy neutrino and dark-matter programme. Its low-threshold germanium data at Kuo-Sheng have been used to constrain WIMPs and bosonic dark matter; inclusion is based on those results, not simply on its neutrino research.
detection_principle: Low-capacitance germanium devices measure small ionization signals, with anticoincidence shielding and low-background operation, to search for low-mass WIMP recoil spectra and absorption signals.

sites.name: Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory
sites.location: Near-reactor experimental facility, Kuo-Sheng nuclear power plant, New Taipei, Taiwan

status.evidence: A 2026 collaboration paper continues new-physics searches using Kuo-Sheng Ge data; this does not demonstrate continued operation of the original reactor.

results.summary: Ultra-low-energy germanium data constrain low-mass WIMP spin-independent and spin-dependent couplings.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
